author: ExcuseMi
description: Runs Playwright tests against TRMNL plugins in the trmnlp format: webhook, polling, static and serverless transforms (Python, Ruby, Node, PHP) with mocked HTTP and a frozen clock, on every TRMNL device model and framework version. The launcher runs the ghcr.io/excusemi/trmnlp-test Docker image.

author: Will Hibbard
description: Extracts barcodes (QR and every symbology zxing-cpp can read) from PNG, JPEG, TIFF, GIF, BMP, WebP, HEIF, PNM and PDF inputs in any orientation.
